sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Coercive control is one of the most harmful forms of DFV. It often happens without physical violence.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: Coercive control includes monitoring, isolation, threats, manipulation, and restricting freedom or choices.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Parents learn to map controlling behaviours and understand how they create fear and dependency.

sections.title: Activity
sections.content: Identify behaviours that made you feel small, scared, or controlled. These may be signs of coercive control.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.content: Recognising coercive control helps parents understand their experiences and seek appropriate support.
